run_rloo_vlm_training: run RLOO reinforcement learning training on a vision-language model with multimodal dataset and reward functions
configure_rloo_trainer: configure an RLOOTrainer with a model, reward functions, and train/eval datasets for multimodal RLHF
build_multimodal_dataset: build a multimodal dataset from HuggingFace with image filtering, RGB conversion, and conversation formatting
quantize_model_peft: quantize a vision-language model and configure PEFT/LoRA for efficient fine-tuning
save_push_trained_model: save a trained RLOO model to disk and optionally push it to a HuggingFace hub repository
